# Checkbox

Select one or several options at a time.
See [Checkbox guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/checkbox/design/)

The `ds-checkbox` class is a simple container for:

- a checkbox input with the `ds-checkbox-input` class
- a label with the `ds-checkbox-label`class

<Canvas of={CheckboxStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Sizes

The checkbox comes in 2 sizes: medium (default), or large.
